name: lifeos
description: LifeOS V1 — Universal user shell for the TrustID ecosystem

scripts.build: npm run build -w @lifeos/shared && npm run build -w @lifeos/shell-core && npm run build -w @lifeos/shell-ui && npm run build -w @lifeos/auth-client && npm run build -w @lifeos/token-network && npm run build -w @lifeos/experience-sdk && npm run build -w @lifeos/ui && npm run build -w @lifeos/api && npm run build -w @lifeos/web && npm run build -w @lifeos/mock-hospitalityos
scripts.build:api: npm run build -w @lifeos/shared && npm run build -w @lifeos/experience-sdk && npm run build -w @lifeos/token-network && npm run db:generate -w @lifeos/api && npm run build -w @lifeos/api
scripts.start: npm run db:push -w @lifeos/api && npm run db:seed -w @lifeos/api && npm run start -w @lifeos/api
scripts.setup: npm install && npm run icons && npm run build -w @lifeos/shared && npm run build -w @lifeos/shell-core && npm run build -w @lifeos/shell-ui && npm run build -w @lifeos/auth-client && npm run build -w @lifeos/token-network && npm run build -w @lifeos/experience-sdk && npm run build -w @lifeos/ui && npm run db:generate && npm run db:push && npm run db:seed
scripts.test:serviceos: npm run test:serviceos -w @lifeos/shell && npm run test:serviceos -w @lifeos/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @lifeos/shared && npm run build -w @lifeos/shell-core && npm run build -w @lifeos/shell-ui && npm run typecheck -w @lifeos/api
